links.comparator_used: Baseline zero-shot prompt only: "Diagnose this X-ray image." with no example cases
links.outcome: Overall chest radiograph diagnostic accuracy (percent-correct with partial credit) on 50 images
links.effect: Overall accuracy rose from 28% to 62%. It reached 100% for COPD, pulmonary edema and foreign body, and 80% for pneumothorax, cardiomegaly and pleural effusion. This was a bundled intervention: the 100 labeled example radiographs were combined with the radiologic framework, so the example effect cannot be isolated.
links.tradeoff: Atelectasis accuracy fell from 40% to 20%. Lung cancer (20%) and feeding tube placement (40%) stayed poor, and rib fractures were missed in both conditions. Overall reliability stayed inadequate for independent clinical use. Pilot study with 50 images.
links.quote: Overall accuracy improved from 28% at baseline to 62% after the structured-context intervention.
